subject: Urgent: LuminaHealth latency surge — regional traffic misassignment
messages:
From: Anika Thomas <anika@luminahealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: LuminaHealth SRE Team <sre@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden p95/p99 jump impacting our users (LuminaHealth)

Vanessa —

We started seeing a large jump in RTT for requests to Redwood's Hosted API around 12:20 PDT. Our p95 has gone from ~120ms to ~820ms, p99 is spiking to 2.3s, and we see a small but noticeable uptick in 5xx errors (~0.35%). This is affecting our search index refresh flows and causing timeouts in our ingestion pipeline.

We collected a short timeline and attached a zipped log bundle. Can you route this to your on-call SRE/Network team? Lumina is on a tight launch window today — we need a quick root cause or an ETA for mitigation.

Attachments: support_logs_20270510.zip

—
Anika Thomas
Platform Ops, LuminaHealth
anika@luminahealth.com
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Thomas <anika@luminahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:18:22 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 jump impacting our users (LuminaHealth)

Anika — thanks for the heads up and the logs. I'm escalating now to our network and serving teams (cc'd). We're marking this as P1 and will post updates here.

First notes from a quick glance: the RT histogram in your screenshot shows a sudden right-shift that correlates with inter-region latencies from one of our US edge POPs. I'm asking Marissa and Vivek to check routing tables and any recent configuration rollouts in the last hour.

We'll get back within 30 minutes with an initial mitigation plan.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anika Thomas <anika@luminahealth.com>, LuminaHealth SRE Team <sre@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:31:47 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 jump impacting our users (LuminaHealth)

Looping in our infra folks — quick summary of what I see: starting 12:18 PDT there are a subset of requests from Lumina that were routed through an intermediate regional egress (us-east-2) instead of the expected us-west-2 POP. That adds ~550–700ms extra RTT in many traces. We did a config push to our edge-routing policy at ~12:10 to roll out a small BGP path preference tweak for a subset of tenants; logs indicate Lumina's routes matched the rollout windows.

Proposed immediate mitigation: roll back the last routing preference change for the affected POPs and apply a targeted route override for Lumina's prefix to prefer the west POPs. Vivek — can infra execute rollback + targeted override now? If rollback risks broader customer disruption, we'll apply a per-customer override.

Attachments: lumina_support_summary.pdf (summary + sample traces)

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Production Infrastructure
marissa@redwood.ai
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anika Thomas <anika@luminahealth.com>, LuminaHealth SRE Team <sre@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:49:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 jump impacting our users (LuminaHealth)

We've applied a targeted route override for Lumina's prefixes to prefer their nearest west coast POPs and removed the recent BGP preference tweak for the small cohort. Initial telemetry (1.5 mins in) shows p95 moving from ~820ms -> ~150ms and p99 trending down. Error rate also dropping.

I'll keep the override in place for 90 minutes while we validate stability and then roll a more intentional fix into the edge-policy pipeline. If we see any collateral effects we'll revert to the earlier state and notify.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
SRE — Routing & Edge Services
vivek@redwood.ai
From: Anika Thomas <anika@luminahealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: LuminaHealth SRE Team <sre@luminahealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:03:55 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 jump impacting our users (LuminaHealth)

Thanks — we can confirm the ingestion pipeline recovered once the override applied. We're still pulling logs for the window to help with RCA. Two asks from Lumina: 1) confirmation of the root cause and steps to ensure this doesn't recur, and 2) a request for a 10% usage credit for the five-hour window of degraded performance — the procurement/finance team says that's typically acceptable when outages impact SLAs.

I'll drop the drive link to the full log set once ready.

—
Anika
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Thomas <anika@luminahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, exec-ops@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95/p99 jump impacting our users (LuminaHealth)

Anika — thanks again for the patience and for the artifact drop (link below). Short update for the record:

- Root cause: the recent edge BGP preference tweak unintentionally caused a class of customer prefixes (including Lumina's) to be attracted to an inter-region transit path; this added an extra inter-POP hop and increased RTT for tail latencies.
- Mitigation: targeted override applied at 13:49 PDT restored expected POP affinity; a follow-up config change removed the problematic preference.
- Next steps: Marissa is owning a postmortem and a safety checklist to gate future BGP preference rollouts. We'll provide Lumina with the postmortem, timeline of the configuration rollout, and the raw traces used for diagnosis.

Regarding the credit request, Ben — can you help with commercial guidance? I recommend we offer a 10% account credit for the affected 5-hour window and a complimentary month of Premium Observability for one monitored route as a gesture. Happy to escalate if Lumina pushes back.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/file/d/1a2b3c-lumina-logs
Support ticket: https://app.redwood.ai/support/tickets/72641

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai
